# firezone_okta_auth_provider (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Okta auth provider by id or name. Exactly one of the two must be set. Read-only: auth providers are configured in the Firezone dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Auth providers are configured in the Firezone dashboard, which owns
# the OAuth secrets, so there is no matching resource - this is lookup
# only. Its main use is resolving a provider ID for a firezone_policy
# condition on auth_provider_id.
data "firezone_okta_auth_provider" "corp" {
  name = "Corp SSO"
}

data "firezone_okta_auth_provider" "by_id" {
  id = "42a7f82f-831a-4a9d-8f17-c66c2bb6e205"
}

# Restrict a Policy to sessions established through this provider.
resource "firezone_policy" "sso_only" {
  group_id    = data.firezone_group.engineering.id
  resource_id = firezone_resource.internal_app.id
  description = "Engineering: Okta sign-ins only"

  condition {
    property = "auth_provider_id"
    operator = "is_in"
    values   = [data.firezone_okta_auth_provider.corp.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Auth provider ID. Set this or name, not both. This is the value a firezone_policy condition on auth_provider_id takes.
- `name` (String) Auth provider name, as shown in the dashboard's authentication settings. Set this or id, not both. Fails if more than one provider shares this name.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID. Not a secret; the client secret is never returned by the API.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this provider is the account's default sign-in method.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is disabled. A disabled provider cannot be used to sign in, but Policies may still reference it.
- `issuer` (String) The provider's issuer identifier.
- `okta_domain` (String) Okta domain this provider authenticates against.
